pivot_note: the bun (old rig's spine pivot); the same pivot as every girl sheet
draw_order: draw order: lower, upper (torso + left arm), arm_right_<state> (the flashlight is drawn over its arm), head (a girl_head_poses frame at head_offset, or girl_sprint_head)
clip_note: she rises slowly from prayer: the old rig's exit (the kneel reversed), sampled knees up / lift / fold / rise. The joined hands part (open hands apart on knees up and lift) and the right hand goes back to its rest pose in each state: from fold on, off holds the low torch, none is the empty hand, on is the raised arm and torch, as in the idle. Plays once, then switch to the idle.

pray_rules: Beti PRAY RULES: joined hands part; in off and on the torch leaves the palms with the right hand (one look for both until fold, where each state's idle torch is back); boots option B.
light_note: frames 0-1 draw the same torch in off and on (leaving the palms with the right hand); from frame 2 each state's idle torch (off low, on raised). flashlight_tip is at the lens on every frame.
